setlist.title: Beat It On Down the Line
Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Run Rudolph Run** (2 reviews): Reviewer thinks this may be the best version ever; Reviewer sees it as an upgrade over the Johnny B. Goode that sometimes appears [7][11]
- **Smokestack Lightning** (2 reviews): Described as an absolutely sweltering version; One of only a few versions with both Pigpen and Keith [2][11]
- **Cold Rain & Snow** (1 review): Attendee says a few versions are better, but not many [12]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Singled out along with Cold Rain and Brokedown Palace as highlights [13]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Attendee remembers it as tight [12]
- **Brokedown Palace** (1 review): Called a great version, with Jerry sounding good [2]
- **Casey Jones** (1 other source): The recording has a large cut in this song [1]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Jerry tunes up for about the first minute, which the reviewer felt spoiled the song [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mister Charlie**: rare: 13 archived performances [14]
- **Run Rudolph Run**: rare: 7 archived performances [14]

## The recordings

- **gd71-12-07.sbd.miller.3375.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 150 min; rated 4.77/5 by 26 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound begins somewhat muddy but improves quickly; Reviewer finds the sound essentially perfect: loud, with a well balanced mix; Nasty distortion and crackling on the right channel [2][3][9][13]

## Around the show

- Both Pigpen and Keith Godchaux play keys; Donna Godchaux sits this show out [10]
- Attendee recalls the show being simulcast on WNEW the night before [12]
- Reviewer prefers this show over 11-7 Harding Theater and the 12-14 and 12-15 Hill Auditorium shows [5]
- Reviewer ranks it second favorite, just behind 5-16-72 [7]
- Band is in transition, between the 1968 psychedelic dance band and the 1974 folk-country-groove sound [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-12-07.sbd.miller.3375.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard transferred from reel at 10.5 IPS to DAT then CD, from Merry Prankster tree 6, seeded by Charlie Miller; SHN branch is credited, with a question mark, to Michael Weise [1]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - Dave's Picks Vol 22: 1971-12-07 Felt Forum, New York, NY (2017)](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2017/04/grateful-dead-daves-picks-vol-22-1971.html) [15]
- Poster by Tim O'Shea: [Grateful Dead Close Out Their Lone Felt Forum Run: December 7, 1971](https://nysmusic.com/2024/12/06/grateful-dead-close-out-their-lone-felt-forum-run-december-7-1971/) [16]
